characterCreation.description: Players forge their Code-Tamer hero by writing real Python function calls.

functions.name: set_name
functions.description: Sets your hero's display name (2 to 16 characters).

functions.name: preview_skin
functions.description: Updates the hero's skin tone sprite layer.

functions.name: preview_hair
functions.description: Updates the hero's hairstyle sprite layer.

functions.name: preview_tunic
functions.description: Updates the hero's starter tunic color.

functions.name: confirm_hero
functions.description: Locks in your hero and enters Whispering Meadow.
